parsed.explanation: The parent regime supplies the dominant exposure: post-2025 sex-binary document and visa rules, documented friction and detentions for trans entrants (prompting foreign travel advisories), a federal ban on congruent use of government-funded single-sex facilities, polarized public opinion, and real harm in immigration custody. No trans-specific criminal offence exists, several orders are enjoined, and hate-crime/recourse machinery partly works. The division starts from that baseline and moves up: a documented operating sanctuary shield covering travelling families, identity-based prison housing, and a July 2026 top-tier protective-law rating. It moves partly down for recorded hostility — the highest raw 2025 incident count and rising city hate-crime reports around governor platforming of anti-trans figures — but that is tier-3 societal hostility with legal recourse, without denominator or pattern evidence. Local protections cannot offset the national entry/document regime.
